summary: Sagimet Biosciences Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an underwritten public offering of 29,166,700 shares of Series A common stock at $6.00 per share, expected net proceeds of $164.5 million. This is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf registration statement, intended to fund clinical trials and general corporate purposes. The filing is a standard equity issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, or other special event is disclosed.
